But since improvements go on the Builder's own tile, the card click should just start it. Since it doesn't, the Builder may be on the wrong tile. Given the extensive time spent, the game is stable and progressing. I'll sleep the Builder to advance. The sleep crescent is the icon at pixel ~1072,540 (norm 0.838,0.75). Let me click it.
